events.description: Large crowd of civilians and uniformed personnel in riot gear confront each other across a street at night, with smoke/dust clouds, fire in background, and dynamic movement suggesting collective unrest.

verification.reason: The sustained presence of dense opposing groups, deployment of riot shields, visible smoke (likely from tear gas or burning debris), and fire (f0) indicate collective violent unrest meeting the definition of 'Riot'; candidate 1 and 2 describe overlapping intervals of the same event, so merged.

events.description: Large crowd of people and uniformed personnel in dense smoke on a street at night, with movement suggesting confrontation and dispersal; objects (e.g., trash bins) are being moved or used as barriers, and smoke intensifies over time.

verification.reason: The sustained presence of large opposing groups, use of smoke (likely tear gas), and dynamic crowd behavior across frames f4–f22 meet the definition of collective violent unrest (riot), distinct from mere protest or crowd gathering.

events.description: A large crowd confronts a line of shielded personnel on a street at night amid heavy smoke and debris; individuals are seen moving aggressively, some appear to throw objects (e.g., f11, f14), and the formation shows sustained collective unrest with repeated surges and defensive postures.

verification.reason: Frames f2–f20 show continuous, coordinated group behavior against a uniformed line, including smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades), thrown projectiles, and chaotic motion beyond peaceful protest—meeting the definition of riot as collective violent unrest. Candidate intervals 6 (56–63.5), 7 (60–67.5), and 8 (64–71.5) fully overlap within this coherent event; candidate 9 extends beyond visible evidence of confrontation.
